# Amazon

8 endpoints, all GET. Base URL `https://www.socialcrawl.dev`, auth header `x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY`.

**Credit costs:** 6 standard (1 credit), 1 advanced (5), 1 custom (flat/metered) - the exact cost is in each endpoint heading below.

## GET /v1/amazon/best-sellers - 1 credit (standard)

Returns ranked Amazon Best Seller listings for a category: ASIN, title, price, rating, and image. Pass type to switch to New Releases, Most Wished For, or Gift Ideas. Movers and Shakers is accepted but currently returns an empty list at 0 credits, because Amazon publishes no Movers and Shakers rows on the marketplaces we checked. Amazon serves up to two pages of 50; a page past the last typically 503s and is refunded.

**Use when** you want to read a chart by category slug or department/node path such as officeproduct/202900031, then pass an ASIN into product or reviews.
**Cost** cache 120 s
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈50/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/50) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `category` (required) - Best Sellers category path from the Amazon Best Sellers URL: a department slug such as software or officeproduct, or a department plus node id for a subcategory, such as officeproduct/202900031 (Karten on amazon.de). · e.g. `software`
- `country` (optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL) - Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). · e.g. `US`
- `type` (optional, enum: BEST_SELLERS | NEW_RELEASES | MOVERS_AND_SHAKERS | MOST_WISHED_FOR | GIFT_IDEAS) - List type: BEST_SELLERS (default), NEW_RELEASES, MOST_WISHED_FOR, GIFT_IDEAS, or MOVERS_AND_SHAKERS. MOVERS_AND_SHAKERS currently returns an empty list at 0 credits on US, GB and DE, because Amazon itself shows no Movers and Shakers rows. A category with no list of the requested type also returns empty and free. · e.g. `BEST_SELLERS`
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |
| `product.price.currency` |  |
| `product.price.current` |  |

+2 more (types in the full schema): `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.availability`, `product.brand`, `product.description`, `product.price.original`, `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `amazon/reviews` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get Amazon product reviews. · `amazon/product` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get an Amazon product by ASIN. · `amazon/sellers` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get Amazon sellers and offers for a product.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/best-sellers" \
  --data-urlencode "category=software" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/amazon/deals - 1 credit (standard)

Returns Amazon deals currently on the deals page: title, deal price, list price, savings, and the ASIN to look up with GET /v1/amazon/product.

**Use when** you want to list what is on sale now, then look up a deal's ASIN with the product endpoint.

**Next** `amazon/product` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Full details for each product. · `amazon/reviews` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get Amazon product reviews. · `amazon/sellers` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get Amazon sellers and offers for a product.

## GET /v1/amazon/product - 5 credits (advanced)

Returns full product detail for an Amazon ASIN: title, brand, description, price, rating, image gallery, specifications, and variant ASINs. For this product's customer reviews, call GET /v1/amazon/reviews with the same ASIN (shared upstream call).

**Use when** you already have the ASIN and need full product detail rather than search results. For its reviews, call the reviews endpoint.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `asin` (required) - 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier). · e.g. `B0FQFB8FMG`
- `country` (optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL) - Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Note: non-US marketplaces (especially EU) are best-effort: the upstream provider is slower and occasionally times out for these; such calls are refunded, and US is the most reliable marketplace. · e.g. `US`

**Response** `Product` object at `data`, `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/Product.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |

+9 more (types in the full schema): `product` {description, specifications, variations}; `product.ext` {bought_past_month}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`.

**Next** `amazon/reviews` (`asin` ← `data.product.id`) - Customer reviews of the product. · `amazon/sellers` (`asin` ← `data.product.id`) - Get Amazon sellers and offers for a product.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/product" \
  --data-urlencode "asin=B0FQFB8FMG" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/amazon/product-search - 1 credit (standard)

Returns organic Amazon search results for a keyword: title, price, list price, rating, image, and ASIN per product. Where Amazon shows its monthly purchase badge, `product.ext.bought_past_month_label` carries Amazon's text in the marketplace's own language ("9K+ bought in past month", "2000+ Mal im letzten Monat gekauft") and `product.ext.bought_past_month` its LOWER BOUND as an integer (9000; a badge reading "2000+" means at least 2000, not exactly 2000). Parsed for US, GB, CA, AU, IN, DE, FR, IT, ES, MX, NL, BR and JP. Both are null when the row shows no badge, and the number is null on a badge with no count ("New on Amazon in past month") or in a wording we have not parsed (the label is still returned as-is). Calls served from the secondary source, or made with `depth`, carry the number without a label. Multiply it by `price.current` per `country` for an estimate of monthly spend by marketplace. Results reflect the chosen marketplace (default United States). Sponsored placements and related searches are excluded in v1. Paginate with the universal cursor parameter; pass depth instead if you need a single large page.

**Use when** you have a keyword and need to find products or their ASINs, then call the product endpoint for full detail.
**Cost** cache 120 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** page (native `page`) · ≈16/page (observed once) · depth unknown · N items ≈ ceil(N/16) x 1 credits

**Query params**

- `query` (required) - Search keyword or phrase. · e.g. `wireless earbuds`
- `country` (optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL) - Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Non-US marketplaces are best-effort; an occasional timeout is refunded. · e.g. `US`
- `depth` (optional, integer) - Maximum number of products to return in ONE call (default 20, max 700). Use it when you would rather make a single large request than paginate: it selects a different, slower search backend whose latency grows with depth, and a timeout is auto-refunded. Leave it unset for the fast default page size, which is the better choice for keyword→ASIN resolution.
- `page` (optional, integer, 1-100) - Page number, starting at 1. Prefer the universal cursor parameter.

**Response** `ProductList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ product }` ([full schema](schemas/ProductList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `product.id` | Platform product ID… |
| `product.title` | Product title |
| `product.url` | Direct URL to the product page |
| `product.availability` | Stock/availability string when surfaced (only when the fallback source serves) |
| `product.brand` | Brand name (cleaned). (only when the fallback source serves) |
| `product.image_urls` | Primary image URL, or an array of image URLs for products… |

+10 more (types in the full schema): `product` {description, specifications, variations}; `product.ext` {bought_past_month, bought_past_month_label}; `product.price` {currency, current, original}; `product.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `product.reviews_count`, `product.seller`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `amazon/reviews` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Customer reviews of each product. · `amazon/product` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get an Amazon product by ASIN. · `amazon/sellers` (`asin` ← `data.items[].product.id`) - Get Amazon sellers and offers for a product.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/product-search" \
  --data-urlencode "query=wireless earbuds" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/amazon/reviews - 5-9 credits (request-shaped)

Returns the customer reviews shown on an Amazon product page (by ASIN), typically around 8 per product. Each review carries the full text, star rating, reviewer, verified-purchase flag, helpful-vote count, and any review images. A product with no on-page reviews returns a refunded empty list.

**Use when** you want what shoppers wrote about an ASIN. This is one page of on-page reviews, not a full review crawl. **Not for** a rating comparison across shops with themed pros and cons (prism/product-reviews) or whether the ratings look genuine (prism/review-integrity).
**Cost** price moves with `label` · cache 300 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Pricing** 5 credits per page. The default labels (sentiment, issue) are free. label=reports, incentivized or injection holds 4 extra credits and refunds down to 1 credit per started 25 reviews that were newly judged (the first 100 reviews of a page are judged): reviews already labelled are free, a page where nothing could be judged refunds the whole extra, and a cached page is free.
**Paging** single page - Both sources return one fixed page of on-page reviews and expose no honest pagination: /amazon/product-reviews repeats the same 8 review ids on page 1, 2 and 50 (measured 2026-08-29), and the fallback source controls page size by depth in a single call.

**Query params**

- `asin` (required) - 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier). · e.g. `B0BTYCRJSS`
- `country` (optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL) - Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Amazon shows reviews across a product's whole variant family, so a review row can originate from a sibling ASIN; review.entity_id is always the ASIN you requested. · e.g. `US`
- **Shared controls** `label` (sentiment | issue | reports | incentivized | injection; paid: reports, incentivized, injection) · `label_evidence` · `reports` → [labels](api-overview.md#labels-relevance-and-quality)

**Response** `ReviewList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ computed, review }` ([full schema](schemas/ReviewList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `review.text` | Full review body |
| `review.id` | Review ID (parsed from the review URL when not first-class) |
| `review.published_at` | Review creation timestamp as an ISO 8601 UTC string… |
| `computed.labels_evidence` | When 1, every labelled row also carries… (with `label_evidence=1`) |
| `review.entity_id` | ID of the reviewed entity… |
| `review.helpful_votes` | Helpful-vote count (Amazon; null elsewhere) |

+16 more (types in the full schema): `review` {verified, title, url, images}; `computed.labels` {incentivized, injection, issue, reports, sentiment}; `review.author` {name, url, avatar_url, location, reviews_count}; `review.rating` {max, value}. Never filled: `review.language`, `review.original_language`, `review.responses`, `review.source`, `review.translated`. Page-level: `data.dropped`, `data.estimate`, `data.held_back`, `data.labels`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/reviews" \
  --data-urlencode "asin=B0BTYCRJSS" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/amazon/seller - 1 credit (standard)

Returns one Amazon seller by seller id: name, store URL, rating, ratings count, and business name. Seller ids appear on offer rows from GET /v1/amazon/sellers.

**Use when** you already have a seller id from sellers offer rows and want that seller's profile, not the offers on one ASIN.
**Cost** cache 900 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `seller_id` (required) - Amazon seller id, the seller= value on a seller profile URL. · e.g. `A294P4X9EWVXLJ`
- `country` (optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL) - Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). · e.g. `US`

**Response** `Seller` object at `data`, `{ seller }` ([full schema](schemas/Seller.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `seller.name` | Seller name |
| `seller.id` |  |
| `seller.url` |  |
| `seller.domain` |  |
| `seller.rating.average` |  |
| `seller.rating.count` |  |

Never filled: `seller.annotation`, `seller.availability`, `seller.condition`, `seller.price.base`, `seller.price.currency`, `seller.price.shipping`, `seller.price.tax`, `seller.price.total`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/seller" \
  --data-urlencode "seller_id=A294P4X9EWVXLJ" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/amazon/sellers - 1 credit (standard)

Returns every seller offering a given Amazon ASIN: seller name, price, rating, and condition (new / used / refurbished), including the buy-box winner.

**Use when** you want to compare who sells one ASIN and at what price, rather than pulling that product's own detail or reviews.
**Cost** cache 600 s · multi-source (billed once)
**Paging** single page - Depth-based fan-out: page size is controlled by depth, one call.

**Query params**

- `asin` (required) - 10-character Amazon ASIN (the product identifier). · e.g. `B09SM24S8C`
- `country` (optional, enum: US | GB | CA | DE | FR | IT | ES | JP | IN | MX | BR | AU | NL) - Amazon marketplace as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (default US). Supported: US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IT, ES, JP, IN, MX, BR, AU, NL. Note: non-US marketplaces (especially EU) are best-effort: the upstream provider is slower and occasionally times out for these; such calls are refunded, and US is the most reliable marketplace. · e.g. `US`

**Response** `SellerList` rows at `data.items[]`, each `{ seller }` ([full schema](schemas/SellerList.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `seller.name` | Seller name |
| `seller.condition` | Item condition… |
| `seller.id` |  |
| `seller.url` |  |
| `seller.annotation` |  |
| `seller.price.base` |  |

+4 more (types in the full schema): `seller.price` {currency, total}; `seller.rating` {average, count}. Never filled: `seller.availability`, `seller.domain`, `seller.price.shipping`, `seller.price.tax`. Page-level: `data.dropped`.

**Next** `amazon/seller` (`seller_id` ← `data.items[].seller.id`) - Each seller's profile and rating.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/sellers" \
  --data-urlencode "asin=B09SM24S8C" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```

## GET /v1/amazon/shop - 1 credit (standard)

Returns product listings from an Amazon shop or storefront page including product names, prices, ratings, and images.

**Use when** you have a storefront page URL and want what that seller puts on it, rather than searching the whole catalogue.
**Cost** cache 600 s
**Paging** none

**Query params**

- `url` (required) - Full URL of the Amazon shop or storefront page · e.g. `https://www.amazon.com/shop/sydneydelrey`

**Response** `Post` object at `data`, `{ computed, post }` ([full schema](schemas/Post.md))

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `post.content.text` | Post caption, description, or text content |
| `post.id` | Platform-specific post ID… |
| `post.url` | Direct URL to the post on the source platform |
| `post.author.username` | Author username |
| `computed.content_category` | Keyword-classified content category… |
| `computed.engagement_rate` | Computed engagement rate (0..1). |

+11 more (types in the full schema): `computed` {estimated_reach, language}; `post.author` {avatar_url, display_name, verified}; `post.content` {thumbnail_url}; `post.flags` {deleted}; `post.ext` {amazon_shop_curations, amazon_shop_lists, amazon_shop_socials, amazon_shop_trending_picks}. Never filled: `post.content.duration_seconds`, `post.content.media_urls`, `post.engagement.comments`, `post.engagement.likes`, `post.engagement.saves`, `post.engagement.shares`, `post.engagement.views`, `post.flags.nsfw`, `post.flags.pinned`, `post.flags.spoiler`, `post.published_at`.

```bash
curl -G "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/amazon/shop" \
  --data-urlencode "url=https://www.amazon.com/shop/sydneydelrey" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
